description: Combined certification for configurable orchestration, nested managed agents, the live agent tree, Worker verification, and Settings buffering.

prerequisites.label: Build public workspace types used by extension and webview tests

tracks.label: Worker isolation, Apply, and orphan recovery
Agent runtime policy, registry, capacity, and recovery
Spawn, lifecycle, mailbox, result, and cancellation routing
Awaited terminal and real OS process-tree cleanup
Worker Apply settlement, optional command evidence, and parent completion
Strict native provider and lifecycle protocol
Compact agent task surfaces, transcript controls, and history regressions
Settings buffered-edit and managed-agent configuration regressions

rows.requirement: Settings expose current Codex agent enablement, thread cap, model/effort defaults, interruption messages and custom agents; retired preferences are not writable.

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )saves Codex settings without forwarding retired settings$

rows.requirement: Children retain captured context and authority across reload; old execution ceilings never regain effect.

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )freezes ancestry and effective limits while retaining legacy manifests$
(?:^| )recovers a legacy orchestration omission without reviving execution limits$
(?:^| )rehydrates a child with its frozen delegation policy without reviving role timeouts$

sourceProbes.label: orchestration schema binds ancestry policy and limits

rows.requirement: Live/list projections expose depth, maxDepth, delegationPolicy, effectiveLimits, and terminal stopReason.

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )parses a bounded nested registry projection without raw manifests or report bodies$

probes.label: provider projects durable nested fields and stop reason

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )projects the durable nested registry into a bounded reload-safe webview contract$

probes.label: compact task strip consumes projected hierarchy and terminal state

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )opens active and nested tasks with the exact task id$
(?:^| )keeps status readable without relying on dot color$

rows.requirement: Delegation follows explicit requests or applicable instructions; retired proactive settings cannot grant authority.

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )ignores the retired proactive setting while preserving session grants and task opt-in$
(?:^| )allows a per-task policy to narrow but never widen$
(?:^| )rehydrates a child with its frozen delegation policy without reviving role timeouts$

rows.requirement: Wait timeouts release the parent without stopping the child; legacy execution deadlines have no effect and explicit cancellation still cleans up.

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )keeps working past a legacy execution timeout until explicitly stopped$
(?:^| )settles a blocking wait on .+? and disposes its timer and subscription$
(?:^| )distinguishes parent cancellation and interruption$

rows.requirement: Retired per-child and root token/cost preferences cannot stop work or block new launches after reload; usage and historical stop reasons remain durable.

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )ignores a retired .+? limit across provider requests$
(?:^| )does not revive .+? after deleting the final child's history and reloading$
(?:^| )accepts stable terminal stop reason .+?$

rows.requirement: Authorized descendants have no independent nesting-depth ceiling; parent permission and workspace ceilings still apply.

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )permits nested read-only agents without a depth ceiling while denying authority widening$
(?:^| )allows a Worker to layer one nested Worker only within its frozen directory and exact-file scope$
(?:^| )layers a nested Worker worktree through its owning parent before the root checkout$

rows.requirement: One root-wide capacity pool bounds every descendant and releases slots on terminal transitions.

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )counts descendants against one root cap without serializing another root$
(?:^| )cleans capacity, queued waiters, and run registrations exactly once$
(?:^| )atomically reserves a root slot before asynchronous preparation yields$

rows.requirement: Cancel, interrupt, and close have deterministic descendant/subtree semantics.

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )cancels descendants deepest-first and distinguishes direct-child from deeper target causes$
(?:^| )registers children before publishing running state so immediate cancellation is not lost$
(?:^| )requires bottom-up close and never reuses a retained nested path$

rows.requirement: Mailbox events and terminal results route once to the owning parent with durable cursors and native wait receipts.

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )tracks per-recipient delivery and acknowledgement cursors durably$

probes.label: native wait claim is not consumed by lifecycle rendering

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )does not treat lifecycle rendering as consumption of a native wait result$
(?:^| )releases a reload-preserved native wait claim without a receipt and redelivers the same event once$
(?:^| )ACKs a reload-preserved native wait claim with canonical IDs without redelivery$
(?:^| )ACKs a reload-preserved native wait claim with legacy IDs without redelivery$
(?:^| )ACKs a reload-preserved native wait claim with empty-canonical IDs without redelivery$
(?:^| )ACKs a reload-preserved native wait claim with matching IDs without redelivery$
(?:^| )leaves the next model-facing user content free of child-report injection$

probes.label: managed-child parent-mail wake without consumption or steering

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )wakes a registered child's idle wait for passive parent mail without consuming or steering it$

rows.requirement: Descendant results, messages, waits, and controls use the immediate owning parent and atomic result claims.

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )allocates stable nested identity and routes a grandchild result only to its immediate parent mailbox$
(?:^| )cancels descendants deepest-first and distinguishes direct-child from deeper target causes$

probes.label: concurrent mailbox claim is exactly once

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )grants exactly one durable owner to concurrent native wait consumers$

rows.requirement: Agent messages are delivered at a model-step boundary without steering or answering human prompts, acknowledged only after durable recipient persistence, and recovered on retained follow-up.

probes.label: durable agent input without approval interference

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )keeps messages durable during an approval and retries failed transcript persistence without acknowledging other events$
(?:^| )uses the current report when a retained follow-up completes successfully$
(?:^| )keeps persisted steering and a retained follow-up in distinct user-message envelopes$

rows.requirement: report_progress is a bounded, auto-approved sub-agent-only capability that durably routes once to the immediate parent without result-claim interference.

probes.label: immediate-parent progress routing and exact claim

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )routes nested agent progress only to the immediate parent and lets wait_agent claim it once$
(?:^| )rejects report_progress from roots and when the frozen immediate parent is missing$

probes.label: root and managed-child tool catalog boundary

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )keeps a stable primary Code lifecycle catalog before managed-agent activity$
(?:^| )does not let the stable primary default override a managed child's frozen authority$

probes.label: strict bounded provider and registry contract

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )dispatches every operation without asking for approval$
(?:^| )rejects invalid inputs before calling the provider$
(?:^| )registers the built-in tools with their provider schemas$

rows.requirement: Registry reload and Worker orphan recovery are idempotent on the depth-one baseline.

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )recovers active records once while preserving completed records$
(?:^| )recovers partial changes from an orphaned active worktree after reload$

probes.label: failed capture preserves recoverable Worker changes

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )retains the worktree after a failed .+? capture step and recovers it on reload$
(?:^| )lands the reviewed patch, survives reload without mandatory checks, and records optional evidence once$

rows.requirement: Reload reconstructs nested ownership, usage, mailbox routing and orphan cleanup without flattening or restoring retired limits.

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )recovers nested active records to their immediate parents exactly once$
(?:^| )routes an orphaned descendant recovery notice to the surviving root$

rows.requirement: fork_turns inheritance is frozen, credential-free, digest-checked, and authority-narrowed.

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )captures and applies only the requested parent turns with frozen instructions and skills while keeping the child objective concise$
(?:^| )stores only compact refs and digests and serializes no captured secrets$
(?:^| )rejects a tampered retained context manifest instead of recapturing on follow-up$

rows.requirement: A managed parent cannot complete with active descendants or unowned descendant terminal results.

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )a parent cannot complete while an active descendant is running$
(?:^| )blocks completion while an undelivered completed descendant result remains unowned$
(?:^| )blocks completion while an undelivered failed descendant result remains unowned$

rows.requirement: Completed Workers integrate approved scoped effects before result publication without a second review. Conflicts, partial work, reduced authority and saved proposals remain recoverable; effect settlement gates completion while optional process evidence remains advisory.

probes.label: completed Worker integration without a second review

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )integrates approved .+? Worker effects before publishing a result without a second review$
(?:^| )lands the reviewed patch, survives reload without mandatory checks, and records optional evidence once$
(?:^| )rechecks verification immediately before the terminal transition$
(?:^| )fails closed when the durable completion decision cannot be loaded$

probes.label: optional Worker evidence does not invent completion debt

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )does not block approved Worker changes when optional process evidence is missing or failed$

probes.label: generic evidence does not claim test coverage

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )accepts successful arbitrary process evidence without inferring a test classification$
(?:^| )preserves an external canary when only a generated proposal's patch reference is tampered$

rows.requirement: Managed-agent lifecycle calls survive strict native-provider parsing and parallel tool-call streams.

(?:^| )executes lifecycle controls and named steering in model order$

rows.requirement: A descendant Worker has an explicit evidence owner and the same review, effect-settlement, and pre-terminal completion checks as a root-owned Worker.

probes.label: layered parent and root verification ownership

assertions.pattern: (?:^| )layers Worker verification ownership at each immediate parent$
(?:^| )rechecks verification immediately before the terminal transition$

integrationPending.requirement: Real conversation: explicit-only delegation accepts genuine user authorization and rejects model-inferred/protocol-shaped authorization across reload.
integrationPending.reason: Requires the real conversation/provider boundary to distinguish direct human provenance from generated or replayed records.

integrationPending.requirement: Real VS Code host: nested spawn, root-wide capacity, descendant cancellation, crash/reload, immediate-parent mailbox routing, and orphan cleanup.
integrationPending.reason: Requires extension-host restart and real managed child processes; unit mocks cannot establish process ownership or crash recovery.

integrationPending.requirement: Real provider: long-running agents and compaction continue without generic execution deadlines; explicit cancellation stops provider work and descendant processes.
integrationPending.reason: Deterministic tests establish lifecycle semantics; supplemental live-provider runs establish actual provider and process behavior over long sessions.

integrationPending.requirement: Real VS Code host: completed Workers integrate already-approved effects automatically; concurrent-edit conflicts and recoverable proposals retain Apply/Discard, parent settlement and optional process evidence across reload.
integrationPending.reason: Requires the real extension host, terminal ownership, filesystem worktree, approval-mode transitions, UI review, reload, and completion transition.

integrationPending.requirement: Real webview: compact nested task rows update status and attention, open the exact child without disturbing siblings, retain overflow actions, and preserve Settings unsaved edits across background refreshes.
integrationPending.reason: Requires the live webview/extension message loop and user-visible timing; jsdom does not prove host/webview convergence.

integrationPending.requirement: Real extension-host termination cancels non-cooperative descendant HTTP streams and process trees without leaking capacity.
integrationPending.reason: Requires OS process ownership and provider abort behavior beyond the in-memory runner seams.

integrationPending.requirement: Multiple real extension hosts/windows cannot corrupt shared agent-control state or double-claim mailbox results.
integrationPending.reason: Requires multi-process writers against the real global-storage filesystem; the in-process store singleton cannot prove this.

integrationPending.requirement: Real extension-host global state remains below its configured compatibility budget during managed-agent churn and reload.
integrationPending.reason: The deterministic compaction tests prove helper behavior only; real VS Code storage serialization and multi-window reload require dedicated host instrumentation.
